why: rclc makes the user init each lifecycle server separately and hand it a context struct. `rclc_executor_register_lifecycle_services` registers all five REP-2002 servers (`~/change_state`, `~/get_state`, `~/get_available_states`, `~/get_available_transitions`, `~/get_transition_graph`) in ONE call, explicitly, because each server is a zenoh queryable against `ZPICO_MAX_QUERYABLES` (issue 0460) -- see the service stage's `c:executor_register_lifecycle_services`. We also register five servers where rclc offers three, adding `~/get_available_transitions` and `~/get_transition_graph` so `ros2 lifecycle list` works against an embedded node.
